description.value:
Whether you favor the long katana of a swordmaster, a brace of shuriken, or the strings of a puppeteer, you treat weapons as extensions of your nerve, not just your hand. Most Weapon Masters wield chakra primarily through their tools — a chakra-laced blade is your jutsu.

Hit Points 10 + Constitution

Key Attribute Strength or Dexterity

Initial Proficiencies trained in simple and unarmed, expert in martial; trained in light/heavy armor, expert in medium; expert Fortitude and Reflex, trained Will; trained in Crafting plus 3 additional skills

Spellcasting none, but you gain Charge Chakra so weapon-channeled techniques (from later milestones) can be paid for in slots.

At 1st level you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChargeChakr0]{Charge Chakra}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtWeaponMSpc00]{Weapon Master Specialization}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtWeaponMPth00]{Weapon Discipline}.
